sources.entry: daily.dev by daily.dev - Useful skills and plugins based on daily.dev platform which contains daily curated news from trusted sources. Your agent can pull from curated list of news and real developer insights from 1M+ community.

summary.one_liner: Central hub repository for daily.dev, a free, open source personalized news feed and developer community, with links to its related projects.
summary.what_it_does: This repository is the central hub for the daily.dev project rather than a standalone tool. The README describes daily.dev as a personalized feed that aggregates articles, tutorials, release notes, and news from 2,000+ sources, with tags and reading activity shaping the feed. It covers the browser new-tab extension for Chrome and Edge, a web app, and iOS and Android apps. It also describes Squads (developer communities), comments, bookmarks, and search. The FAQ says every account can create a personal access token for a public API, and that an MCP server is available for agents such as Claude, Cursor, and Codex. The README lists sibling repositories (docs, apps monorepo, awesome-developer-essentials, action-devcard) and invites bug reports and feature requests here.
use_cases: Read a personalized developer news feed
Replace the browser new tab with a developer homepage
Find developer articles and tutorials by tag
Join developer communities to discuss posts
Pull daily.dev feed or search results into scripts via API
Connect an AI agent to daily.dev through MCP
how_to_run: Install the daily.dev browser extension from the Chrome or Edge store, or use the web app or mobile apps
stack: Public API with personal access tokens
notable: Free and open source under AGPL-3.0, with the frontend in the dailydotdev/apps monorepo
New-tab extension that states it does not track browsing on other sites or read page content
Public API and MCP server for Claude, Cursor, Codex and similar agents, with sign-in instead of a token copy
Feed personalization by followed tags, sources, and reading, upvotes, and bookmarks
Squads for team or interest-based discussion
caveats: Repository is a hub and documentation center; the application code lives in other repositories such as dailydotdev/apps
Ad-supported: the feed includes native ads, and an optional paid tier called daily.dev Plus exists
Available only as a Chrome/Edge extension, web app, and iOS/Android apps; no desktop app or other browsers are mentioned
keywords: stay up to date with tech
